body.zh-Hant: 馬德羅1873年10月30日生於科阿韋拉州帕拉斯，出身北方最富有的家族之一。1893年他定居聖佩德羅德拉斯科洛尼亞斯，接管家族事業；他作為企業主以重視社會正義著稱，並學習、實踐順勢療法來幫助莊園的雇工。1903年他與莎拉·佩雷斯·羅梅羅成婚。
body.en: Francisco I. Madero was born in Parras, Coahuila, on 30 October 1873 into one of the wealthiest families of northern Mexico. In 1893 he settled in San Pedro de las Colonias to take charge of the family businesses, where as an employer he was known for seeking greater social justice and for learning and practising homeopathy to help the estate's day labourers. In 1903 he married Sara Pérez Romero.

citations.quote: nació en Parras, Coahuila, el 30 de octubre de 1873
en el seno de una de las familias más acaudaladas del norte del país
En 1893 se estableció en San Pedro de las Colonias
con la finalidad de hacerse cargo de los negocios familiares
Madero se caracterizó por buscar una mayor justicia social
aprendió y ejerció la homeopatía para ayudar a los jornaleros
En 1903, contrajo matrimonio civil y religioso con Sara Pérez Romero

heading.zh-Hant: 報刊、著作與反連任競選
heading.en: Journalism, writing and the anti-reelection campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1904年馬德羅投身新聞與政治，在地方報紙《民主人士》發表談人權、選舉權與自由的文章；1908年他寫成《1910年的總統繼任》，嚴厲批評迪亞斯長期掌權。1910年4月15日，他在反連任黨大會上被提名為總統候選人；同年6月7日在蒙特雷被迪亞斯政府逮捕，10月5日他在聖安東尼奧發表《聖路易斯計畫》。
body.en: In 1904 Madero entered journalism and politics, publishing articles on human rights, suffrage and liberty in the local newspaper El Demócrata. In 1908 he wrote The Presidential Succession in 1910, a harsh critique of Porfirio Díaz's absolute power. On 15 April 1910 he was named candidate for the presidency at the Great Convention of the Anti-Reelectionist Party; he was arrested in Monterrey on 7 June 1910, and on 5 October 1910 the Plan of San Luis was published in San Antonio, Texas.

citations.quote: En 1904 incursionó en el periodismo y la política
En 1908 escribió su libro La sucesión presidencial en 1910
El 15 de abril de 1910
fue nombrado candidato a la Presidencia de la República
siendo aprehendido en Monterrey el 7 de junio de 1910
el 5 de octubre de 1910, se publicó el Plan de San Luis

heading.zh-Hant: 革命、迪亞斯下台與當選
heading.en: Revolution, Díaz's fall and the 1911 election

body.zh-Hant: 1911年5月10日，奧羅斯科與維拉攻占華雷斯城，成為擊垮迪亞斯政府的最後一擊；迪亞斯於5月25日辭職，馬德羅6月7日進入首都。同年8月他創立憲政進步黨並成為該黨總統候選人，在10月的選舉中大勝，但他最後只執政15個月。
body.en: On 10 May 1911 Pascual Orozco and Francisco Villa captured Ciudad Juárez, the final blow to Díaz's government; Díaz resigned on 25 May and Madero entered the capital on 7 June 1911. In August he founded the Progressive Constitutional Party, of which he was the presidential candidate, and won the October elections overwhelmingly, but he was able to govern for only 15 months.

citations.quote: Pascual Orozco y Francisco Villa capturaron Ciudad Juárez
El golpe de gracia para el gobierno porfirista se dio el 10 de mayo de 1911
Porfirio Díaz renunció a la presidencia el 25 de mayo
Madero ingresó a la capital del país el 7 de junio de 1911
En agosto fundó el Partido Constitucional Progresista
consiguió una aplastante victoria en las elecciones realizadas en octubre
sólo pudo gobernar 15 meses

heading.en: The Ten Tragic Days and assassination

body.zh-Hant: 1913年2月9日「悲慘十日」爆發，馬德羅不得不任命維多利亞諾·韋爾塔為軍事司令；2月18日他與副總統何塞·馬里亞·皮諾·蘇亞雷斯在國家宮被捕並被迫簽署辭呈，韋爾塔接任總統。2月22日兩人被送往萊昆貝里監獄，並在該建築後方遭殺害。
body.en: When the Ten Tragic Days broke out on 9 February 1913, Madero had no choice but to appoint Victoriano Huerta as military commander. On 18 February Madero and Vice-President José María Pino Suárez were imprisoned in the National Palace and forced to sign their resignations while Huerta assumed the presidency. On 22 February 1913 they were taken to the Lecumberri Penitentiary and killed behind the building.

citations.quote: Al estallar la llamada Decena Trágica el 9 de febrero de 1913
Madero no tuvo otra opción que nombrar comandante militar a Victoriano Huerta

El 22 de febrero de 1913, Madero
ambos fueron asesinados a espaldas de dicho edificio

body.zh-Hant: 亞歷山大·燦科夫（保加利亞語 Александър Цанков）1879年6月29日生於保加利亞的奧里亞霍沃。德國國家圖書館的 GND 權威檔以 Cankov, Aleksandăr 為規範名，並把他歸為政治家，註明他是政治家兼總理；法國國家圖書館的人名權威記錄同樣載明他生於1879年6月29日的奧里亞霍沃。
body.en: Aleksandar Tsankov (Bulgarian: Александър Цанков) was born on 29 June 1879 in Oryahovo, Bulgaria. The German National Library's GND authority record uses Cankov, Aleksandăr as the preferred name, classes him as a politician and notes that he was a politician and prime minister (Ministerpräsident); the French National Library's authority record likewise gives his birth on 29 June 1879 in Oriahovo.

"label" : "Politiker"

heading.zh-Hant: 索非亞大學的學術生涯

body.zh-Hant: 索非亞大學年刊（經濟學院第10卷）中 Roska Rusinova 的論文記載：1911年燦科夫被選為政治經濟學的正式講師（редовен доцент），除理論政治經濟學外，還講授經濟政策以及價值與價格理論；1919年他被選為正教授，並出任大學校長（ректор）。
body.en: According to Roska Rusinova's article in the yearbook of Sofia University (Faculty of Economics, vol. 10), Tsankov was elected a full docent in political economy in 1911; besides theoretical political economy he also taught economic policy and the theory of value and prices. In 1919 he was elected full professor and rector of the University.

citations.quote: 1911 г. за редовен доцент по политическа икономия е избран Александър Цанков
чете и курсове по икономическа политика и теория за ценността и цените

body.zh-Hant: 保加利亞科學院歷史研究所《歷史評論》（Исторически преглед，2005年第3–4期）刊載 Pencho Penchev 論文，其摘要寫道：1923年6月9日的政變推翻了亞歷山大·斯塔姆博利伊斯基的政府，新任總理是燦科夫教授（Prof. Al. Cankov）；該文並比較斯塔姆博利伊斯基政府與「民主協議」第一屆政府在土地改革、稅收政策、勞動義務等方面的經濟立法。
body.en: The abstract of Pencho Penchev's article in Istoricheski pregled (Institute of Historical Studies, Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, 2005 no. 3-4) states that the coup d'état on 9 June 1923 overthrew the government of Alexander Stamboliyski and that the new prime minister was Prof. Al. Cankov; the article compares the economic legislation of the Stamboliyski government and the first government of the Democratic Agreement on agrarian reform, tax policy, labour duty and other matters.

body.zh-Hant: 埃米利亞諾·菲格羅亞·拉臘因1866年7月12日生於聖地牙哥，父親是前議員弗朗西斯科·德保拉·菲格羅亞·阿勞斯，他有八名兄弟姐妹，其中哈維爾·安赫爾與華金後來也成為國會議員。他先後就讀聖伊格納西奧學校與國立學院，之後進入智利大學法律系，1889年取得律師資格。
body.en: Emiliano Figueroa Larraín was born in Santiago on 12 July 1866, the son of former deputy Francisco de Paula Figueroa Araoz, and had eight siblings, among them the later parliamentarians Javier Angel and Joaquín Figueroa Larraín. He studied at the Colegio San Ignacio and the Instituto Nacional, then read law at the University of Chile and qualified as a lawyer in 1889.

body.zh-Hant: 菲格羅亞所屬政黨為自由民主黨，1900年起當選眾議員，先後代表拉維多利亞與梅利皮亞、雷雷與普查凱、伊塔塔選區；1905年10月31日至1906年5月15日擔任眾議院第一副議長。蒙特總統任內他兩度出任司法與公共教育部長，分別是1907年6月12日至10月25日，以及1909年9月15日至1910年9月6日。
body.en: A member of the Partido Liberal Democrático, Figueroa was elected deputy from 1900 for La Victoria y Melipilla, then Rere y Puchacay and Itata, and served as first vice-president of the Chamber from 31 October 1905 to 15 May 1906. Under President Pedro Montt he was twice Minister of Justice and Public Instruction, from 12 June to 25 October 1907 and from 15 September 1909 to 6 September 1910.

body.zh-Hant: 1910年蒙特總統與繼任的內政部長費爾南德斯·阿爾瓦諾相繼去世後，菲格羅亞因是內閣任職最久的部長而被任命為共和國副總統，自9月6日任職至12月23日，期間主持智利獨立百年慶典，並於12月23日把權力移交給巴羅斯盧科。
body.en: After President Montt and his successor as vice-president, Interior Minister Elías Fernández Albano, died in 1910, Figueroa was named Vice-President of the Republic as the longest-serving minister in the cabinet. He held the office from 6 September to 23 December 1910, presided over the Centenary celebrations, and handed over power to Ramón Barros Luco on 23 December.

El 23 de diciembre de ese mismo año, realizó el traspaso del mando

body.zh-Hant: 1911年7月7日起，他出任智利駐西班牙全權公使至1912年；1914至1920年間先後任智利駐阿根廷與駐西班牙大使。回國後獲任命為不動產登記官，並進入裁決1920年總統選舉的榮譽法庭。
body.en: From 7 July 1911 he was Chile's minister plenipotentiary in Spain until 1912, and between 1914 and 1920 he served as ambassador first in Argentina and then in Spain. Back in Chile he was appointed conservador de Bienes Raíces and sat on the Tribunal de Honor that ruled on the 1920 presidential election.

body.zh-Hant: 1925年10月24日，他在得到自由、保守、激進與民主各黨支持的總統選舉中獲勝，12月23日就任，內閣中的卡洛斯·伊瓦涅斯上校任戰爭部長，其後掌握政治實權；菲格羅亞於1927年4月7日提出辭職。其後他於1928年出任駐秘魯大使，1929年底被任命為中央銀行總裁，1931年5月16日因車禍去世。
body.en: On 24 October 1925 he won the presidential election with the support of the Liberals, Conservatives, Radicals and Democrats, and took office on 23 December 1925; Colonel Carlos Ibáñez del Campo sat in his cabinet as Minister of War and later held effective power. Figueroa resigned on 7 April 1927. He was ambassador to Peru in 1928, was named president of the Central Bank at the end of 1929, and died in a car accident on 16 May 1931.
